app.name: CarShine Red Sea
app.description: Premium mobile car detailing service in El Gouna, Hurghada, and Egypt Red Sea region.
app.audience: Car owners, luxury vehicle owners, yacht owners, expats in El Gouna and Hurghada.
app.problem: Harsh desert dust, salty sea air, and intense sun destroy car paint and interiors. Finding high-quality, reliable, and convenient detailing is hard.
app.differentiator: Mobile waterless and eco-friendly premium detailing at your doorstep, utilizing ceramic coatings and high-end German products.
